description: This file defines React components for rendering customizable charts using the Recharts library, including chart containers, tooltips, legends, and style management.

methods.name: useChart
methods.description: Custom React hook to access chart context with configuration data.

methods.name: ChartContainer
methods.description: Main component that provides chart context and rendering container with styling.

methods.name: ChartStyle
methods.description: Component that injects CSS variables based on chart configuration themes.

methods.name: ChartTooltipContent

methods.description: Component rendering customized legend content for chart series.
